name: Ready Hero Fit! Rowing Fitness Adventure
summary:
🌈 WELCOME TO THE FUTURE OF VR FITNESS Ready Hero Fit transforms your daily exercise into a thrilling interstellar adventure! 🌌 Say goodbye to boring workouts and immerse yourself in a VR rowing experience that engages your full body and mind.

🚣‍♂️ THE ULTIMATE ROWING GAME Ignite your fitness journey in this immersive sci-fi rowing adventure. Whether you are using your resistance bands for calisthenics or sitting at a real rowing machine, Ready Hero Fit tracks your movement and syncs it with your in-game
